correctness.rationale: The incident-average vertex mass yields the exact weighted quartic defect. Coercivity in signed squares gives compact H1 interpolants; the stronger coefficient six holds locally off the zero set of the continuum limit. Weighted lower semicontinuity gives liminf at least six times the antiperiodic weighted Rayleigh minimum. The minimizing Sturm–Liouville eigenfunction is C2 with finitely many simple zeros, and its signed square root gives a matching recovery sequence whose fourth-power mesh error is O(n^-2). Even-cycle equality and odd-cycle strictness follow directly from the equality conditions of the defect. The finite script is supporting algebra only.

value.rationale: This determines the exact leading spectral-edge defect for every smooth positive profile of nonuniform cycle conductances, not merely the unweighted special case. It identifies the natural variable-coefficient antiperiodic Sturm–Liouville quantity governing nonlinear near-bipartite extrema, a transferable structural relation between weighted finite-dimensional operator norms and continuum geometry. A discrete finite table or elementary substitution would not explain this limit.
